citations.assessment: The pointed entry expressly mentions Zekharyah in a parenthesis concerning the Cutheans and assigns Savya to another witness. The checked Tanchuma names Dostai and Savya. Preserve the reported variants.

holds.reason: The pointed entry reports Zekharyah parenthetically. In the checked sources the king of Assyria sends an unnamed priest in II Kings, and alternative witnesses name Dostai with Yannai or Savya. The direct Zekharyah witness remains held.

notes.text: II Kings records the Assyrian king’s instruction to send a priest. Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer’s checked text names Dostai and Yannai, so does not attest Zekharyah by name.
